rules.title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) - allowable annual rent increase
rules.requirement: For covered older rental units, rent may be raised only once every 12 months, by the allowable percentage set by the city. Since Feb. 2, 2026 no extra percentage for utilities or for an added dependent is allowed; a 10% increase for an additional non-dependent tenant is still permitted.
rules.citation: L.A. Mun. Code ch. XV, § 151.00 et seq.
rules.quoted_span: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage
rules.effective_date_note: Date of the current formula changes (no utility add-on, no dependent add-on) stated by LAHD; the underlying RSO is much older and its original date is not in the document.
rules.key_value: Once per 12 months, by the annual allowable percentage published by LAHD
rules.exemptions: Condominiums/townhomes: rent not regulated for tenancies that commenced after Dec. 31, 1995. Luxury exemption available by application.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental properties first built on or before October 1, 1978, plus replacement units under LAMC 151.28; includes apartments, duplexes, ADUs, rooms in hotels held over 30 days, and mobile homes in parks.
rules.conflict_note: Another source (landlord association) may give 2026-01-24 as the effective date of the new formula; LAHD states 2026-02-02. Local RSO governs over the state Tenant Protection Act where it applies.
rules.interaction: Local RSO covers the unit instead of the state cap (Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.12) where both would apply.

rules.title: Los Angeles RSO - legal reasons for eviction, notices and relocation assistance
rules.requirement: Landlords of RSO units may evict only for listed at-fault or no-fault reasons. Eviction notices must be filed with LAHD within 3 business days of service, no-fault evictions require relocation assistance and a Landlord Declaration of Intent to Evict, and the Notice of Right to Counsel must be attached to eviction notices.
rules.quoted_span: No-fault evictions require the payment of relocation assistance.
rules.effective_date_note: Document does not give an original effective date; right-to-counsel notice required beginning 2025-08-20.
rules.key_value: Just cause required; relocation assistance for no-fault evictions; 30-day and 60-day notices for no-fault
rules.coverage_conditions: Rental units subject to the RSO (generally first built on or before Oct. 1, 1978).
rules.interaction: Units not covered by RSO remain subject to the separate city Just Cause Ordinance (named only).

parsed.doc_summary: LAHD RSO overview (updated Sept. 22, 2026): covers LA's Rent Stabilization Ordinance coverage (built on or before Oct. 1, 1978), annual rent-increase rules with Feb. 2, 2026 changes, and just-cause/no-fault eviction, notice and relocation requirements. No security deposit, screening, or algorithmic rent-setting rules are stated.
